title: fix: stop storing prompts in the legacy text cache
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The legacy text cache stops storing full prompts and request URLs alongside cached responses. It also removes unused cache readers and request-header logging. Cache keys, hits, and responses are unchanged. The PR deletes an obsolete secrets-deployment script and adds a text-cache CI job and storage regression test; all six cache tests pass.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli removes prompt notes from a lime green (#ecf874) cache cabinet while a friendly CRT monitor robot checks that the response cards stay the same; code-plants sprout nearby in soft mint-to-peach light. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny archivist's cap, stays small-to-medium sized beside the cabinet, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic—cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
